remaining_scientific_limits: The instrument measures exact-key retrieval and reproduction of supplied admissibility notes; it does not validate general scientific interpretation, resource discovery, or end-user utility.

A exact target-source support is0/60 by construction. A generic schema-aware safe-abstention policy matches56/60tasks and276/288fields. Pooling A/B/C accuracy would conflate support with representation.
B and C both receive the already selected record, same scope qualifications and same conventional candidate rows. B is a repackaged singleton-table packet, not realistic uncurated table search.
Human and development exact records are excluded, but source constructs and qualification facts recur. New record keys do not imply independent scientific knowledge.
Three aliases are OpenAI variants, not independent providers or confirmed independent model families; effective backend version, temperature and sampling seed are unknown/uncontrollable.
Instruction-only isolation cannot establish technical blinding. Actual packet reads/writes and tool traces must be preserved; self-report alone cannot certify isolation.
The ten-item feasibility subset cannot stand in for60tasks. Each stratum has onlyoneitem, no confirmatory significance claim or general interface-superiority claim is supported.
Full-benchmark source-weighted intervals are exploratory reweighting sensitivities with13sleep and27outcome source IDs, not validated population or provider confidence intervals.
Historical source values and hold qualifications were checked against frozen inputs; raw GWAS validity, redistribution rights and human scoring readiness are separate unresolved domains.
freeze_requirements: Freeze the reviewed dataset/protocol/scorer/registry/packets/gold hashes together before any final response.

Report missing/unevaluable cells separately and keep the primary endpoint strict all-required-fields-correct task rate.
Any later substantive task/gold/scoring correction must preserve original hashes and analyses; no response-driven retuning.
